x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Given an agreed SLA matrix, When a P1 incident is created, Then response and resolution task SLAs attach with the agreed schedule Given an incident is placed On Hold – Awaiting Caller, When the SLA is evaluated, Then the timer pauses per the pause condition
